tools.name: web_extract

tools.description: Collect structured data from ONE page: fetch it through the safe transport and extract repeated records with a CSS selector (or the page's tables). Deterministic and honest: no match is a confirmed zero on the delivered page (a client-rendered page needs the browser tools); a failed fetch is unavailable. Results are COLLECTED, untrusted page data — never a verified source; cite the page, not Eclipse, for what it says.

attribute.description: Read this attribute instead of the element text (e.g. 'href').

fields.description: Optional field → child CSS selector, e.g. {"name": "td:nth-child(1)", "price": "td.price"}. Without it, each record's text (or `attribute`) is one value.

selector.description: CSS selector for the repeated record elements (e.g. 'table tbody tr', '.result-row'). Omit to extract the page's tables (plus a text fallback).

tables.description: Set false to skip table extraction and return page text only.
